steps.en: After separate approval, prepare native packages and an early boot image
steps.zh: 另行获批后准备原生包与早期启动镜像

steps.en: Select a PCI target and arrange loading before NVIDIA
steps.zh: 显式选择 PCI 目标，安排在 NVIDIA 前加载

steps.en: Checks the selected unbound card and loads pinned firmware
steps.zh: 检查选中的未绑定显卡，加载固定固件

steps.en: Attempts selector changes and reset, then yields to the normal driver
steps.zh: 尝试改写速度选择寄存器与重置，再交正常驱动

value.en: An attempted boot-time unlock without patching the runtime driver; benefit and recovery remain unverified
value.zh: 不修改运行时驱动的启动解锁尝试；收益与恢复仍待验证
